scene: Scene: an intimate imperial council pavilion in the mature gardens of Bharamuntacho Zani, old western seasonal court of the Purple Emperor. Eye-level WITHIN a shelter made of dark stained TIMBER beams and deep plum, faded violet and russet TEXTILE awnings, plain cloth without symbols. Strong material identity: overlapping fabric, braided hanging cords, woven reed mats, low cedar council table, rolled plain cushions and a small copper brazier. A side of the pavilion opens directly to damp trees and a garden pond at BLUE HOUR after rain; gold lamplight catches the weave of translucent cloth on the right, twilight reflected in water. No distant city skyline. Modest signs of imperial wealth through textiles rather than monumental architecture. Left foreground a quiet dark fabric fold and empty mat. Atmospheric and private, cool blue-green dusk against very restrained amber lights. Pavilion layout is an artistic interpretation of a seasonal imperial court, no new named institution.

scene: Scene: Bad-Furqorin from the CINNABAR MINE ROAD immediately outside its thick defensive walls at Skyreach foothills. A gritty close low viewpoint beside a weathered timber ore sorting shed and piles of dull reddish ore. Across the middle distance the city's short massive irregular dark-stone wall and square gate crouch between the mountain foot and windswept golden steppe. Distant roofs barely peek over the walls. Sky is storm-grey with one muted late light break. Rough dark rock, weathered timber, tawny dry grass and small vermilion mineral accents; not clean marble. scene: Scene: the surviving Snakefolk island capital's pre-expansion harbor at province 5694, rebuilding slowly after the Great Collapse. Eye-level near tidal water under a dripping tropical tree, dense jungle and mangrove roots along a muddy inlet, low weathered timber harbor shelters and woven reed roofs following the irregular shoreline. Broad smooth curved sloping boardwalks, low doorways and wide ramps suggest inhabitants with serpentine lower bodies WITHOUT showing characters or literal snake statues. A few narrow practical wooden cargo boats, mooring poles, damp ropes and baskets connect the settlement to the archipelago; no naval expansion yet. In the right background jungle-shrouded limestone slopes with a small dark opening hint at the gem cave network, no glowing crystals. Humid dawn mist, moss green, wet umber wood, pale turquoise reflected water and a tiny amber lamp under a roof. Left quiet dark roots and shallow water for character overlay.
